notes: the bare and/or opcodes (ADR-0001): retired at ISA v3 (4.0.0), so this build refuses them with a retired_opcode error, but never emitted by the compiler, which always compiles source-level and/or to jump_if_falsy_or_pop/jump_if_true_or_pop instead (see short_circuit.json). The case stays in the corpus with its expectation frozen, not recomputed, because a sibling claiming ISA v1 or v2 must still run it. Tier 1 by opcode; a v1 sibling must still run these.
docs/isa.md: and/or do not short-circuit - both operands are already on the stack by the time either opcode runs, unlike jump_if_falsy_or_pop/jump_if_true_or_pop
both operands must be booleans; anything else, including :undefined, is a TypeMismatchError
